note: A booster stage set to separate at "Never" stays bolted on to the ground, but the recovery weight subtracted it anyway - so the figure a parachute is sized against was lighter than the object under it. Measured on LEM-IV.ork, whose seven Never configurations showed 2.65 kg for a stack that comes down at 5.46 kg plus its spent casing: 51 percent missing, and a main sized against it lands at least 43 percent faster than predicted. If you fly a design with a stage set to Never, re-open it and re-check the chute. The Recovery sizing panel also no longer offers a booster's parachute as the sustainer's drogue.
